name: Jev
description: TypeSafe AI System One evaluation model. Accepts shared state and typed questions, returning choices, scores, and boolean probabilities. Limits: 64,000 tokens total per request; 32,000 tokens for the state plus the longest question. No streaming or output-token limit.
